reviews.t: These are FAKE! Do not buy them.
reviews.x: These are fake and you CAN'T return them because of "special packaging." I have posted a photo with a real one next to these fake ones and highlighted some of the differences in packaging.

This is a fake product. In the pic, the can on the left is legit, and this one is on the right. It also says on the back "Not for sale in US", which is where I live. The scent is not like the real product, and the ingredients are different. Cannot return item either, so I am stuck with some knock off that was WAY over priced.

I agree with other reviews, calling fake in this one.  I’ve used this product for a long time and love it however, this is not it!  Does not smell the same and does not hold my style AT ALL!!!  I’m about half way through the first can and will throw both away (bought 2 pack) and go buy the real thing.

FAKE - CONTACTED AMAZON 02/18/2019  Have used for the past 5+ years.  Last order does not smell nor hold like all of my previous experience.  I came back to review my order and see that others are saying the same thing.  BUY ELSEWHERE

reviews.t: Melt down your lace front wig!
reviews.x: Loved this so much better than Got2B freeze spray. It’s not as messy when you spray, and becomes tacky very fast! It would usually last about 1-2 days, so for very temporary hold but it gets the job done!

Great product. I have long, thick curly hair and thus spray is my favorite. Even better is this seller. I had ordered the 2pack.  When, several months after ordering, the second can just wouldn't spray (yes, I cleaned off the nozzle under hot water) I contacted the seller. The seller got back to me first thing the next business day to apologize for the inconvenience and said they would send another can to replace the defective one. So, great product and great customer service.  We'll done.

I've used this hairspray for years and it is the best. So when I started using the spray in this order I immediately noticed it wasn't right. The can looks almost identical to the others I use. However, the ingredients aren't even close to the same. I feel like it is false advertising and very misleading. And especially frustrating because I purchased six cans.....that can't be returned. Don't buy this or use this seller.

I tried this in a mini / travel size before purchasing the large bottles.  The mini was AMAZING!!!  So, I bought these. Great deal, right?  Wrong... They are listed as 346ml NOT 10.6oz and before I got to my car, my hair was flat!  The product that was in the mini held my hairstyle ALL DAY - through a baseball game AND a concert!  This stuff didn't hold to my car.  SO disappointed!

This is not real TIGI Bedhead Hard head Hair Spray.  They print on the can is off.  The ingredients is not the same as the ones purchased in the salon.  It does not hold my hair.  Literally too wet and heavy.  I have contacted TIGI.  If this was the real product, it would be a great value.  I purchased 12 cans thinking I was getting a great deal.  I believe it’s illegal to sell fake goods to consumers leading them to believe they are buying TIGI products but it’s actually who knows what.  Not ha

I have purchased this hair spray a few times. I have thought with my last couple purchases something wasn't right, but had blind faith. FIrst, it is nearly impossible to get the cap off.  Second, if you don't get the cap back on right away, it clogs and when you try running it under hot water to declog it, the spray then goes all over when sprayed. Third, it doesn't hold my hair. Don't waste your money on this. Very disappointed in Tigi

reviews.t: Received frozen like and it doesn’t work.
reviews.x: ARE YOU KIDDING ME?? You packed it with no packing and it’s frozen and doesn’t spray and it’s not returnable. THANKS LOVE WASTING MY $$ said no one ever! Would give 0 stars if able.

I have been using this hairspray for the past few years and it's been the best I've ever come across. That's why I knew something was off when I started using these ones I purchased as it would NOT hold my hair in place at all no matter how much I used. It's ridiculous that they are selling fake ones on here.

reviews.t: Pretty sure this is a fake. Not the same wonderful scent as salon.
reviews.x: This smells nothing like the product I purchase at the salon or beauty supply. The can looks like it's the same, but it smells like nail polish. I am pretty sure it's a fake and I am disappointed.  Half of the reason I buy it is because of the scent.

reviews.t: If you have fine hair, this is the spray for you!
reviews.x: I have very fine hair with no body.  Most sprays really weigh my hair down or they don't hold at all.  This spray isn't the best smelling, BUT it really holds.  It's easy to brush through as well.
[[VIDEOID:aa65fcb68355d8d9584d76d25249f506]] I love it hold down my frontal so well dries extremely fast and work beautiful miracles results

After using for a week my hair was unmanageable. No matter how much shampoo or conditioner I used it still felt terrible. I stopped using this product and my hair is normal again. It’s like a glue that doesn’t come out with washing.
Hard head is a fitting description. If you are looking for a light hold, this may not be for you. If you are looking for an all day all night hold, this is for you. The size is perfect for travel.

Hairsprays always promise to hold your hair but leave it soft and brushable.  HOGWASH!  Listen honey, you can either have hair that looks good or hair that feels good.  Pick one.  That's what I love about Hard Head.  They aren't making promises that no one can keep.  This stuff will make your hair a bit hard.  But your hair will look great and stay exactly where you put it -- even through a light sweat.  Hard Head is great!  You can brush it out if you want and of course it washes out easily.  I

reviews.t: Great for fine hair, helps add volume
reviews.x: I have thin, fine hair, and not a lot. So it's been a challenge finding a hair spray that holds, to help create volume, but doesn't weigh my hair down.  I was searching for a good travel size hairspray, and found Mini Hard Head. I was so happy when I used it!  As hairspray is spray glue, my only complaint is that the nozzle does get gunked up quite a bit, but it's a minor inconvenience when the product works well!

reviews.t: The BEST hairspray out there, hands down.
reviews.x: This is really a great hairspray. I have extremely thick, long hair and I style/curl it almost every day. There is very little noticeable damage from repeated/excessive use (I like to use a lot!). Wisconsin summers get pretty humid and this hairspray helps my hair hold up so well... I have an unhealthy obsession with my hair and this is the ONLY hairspray that I have found to be worthy of keeping an all day hold.

reviews.t: Great hold but unpleasant order & dullness.
reviews.x: I purchase many TIGI products & love their shampoos & conditioners. This product has a great hold but leaves a dull residue on your hair taking away any shine your hair may have. It also has an unpleasant smell, like a hair spray from 20 years ago, not like most hair sprays of today that have pleasant odors to them. Will not buy again.

when this stuff said "hard hold" i was skeptical- i've tried hundreds of dollars worth of product that made the same claim. but since this wasn't expensive at all, i'd tried it. O-M-G. this spray is true to its word. it hardens your hair immediately. and the best part is, you dont need to douse your hair in it(major damage). the can is fairly big, so i expect this to last me quite awhile. it also give hair a subtle shine to it. 5 STARS!

reviews.t: Terrible product. It fails with a full tank of spray.
reviews.x: I am new to this brand. Bought it after seeing the good reviews. I opened the first bottle 2 weeks ago and used less than 5% of the product. But now the spray is failing and the glue jamming itself also. Even I tried to wash the spray off the tip, the aerosol still won't fire. Also the cap is impossible to open... terrible product and I wasted $20!

Listen I am a hair stylist and this is not the same bed head you get In stores this had a strong smell and it burned (clients stated) when applying I tried it on myself and they are right if I could give this negative 10 I would and you can't return because it's flammable.. do yourself a favor and just go get it from the store.

reviews.t: Best hairspray for fine, hard to curl hair
reviews.x: Best hairspray I've ever used, hands down. I've used other pricey sprays, and Bed Head Hard Head tops all of them by far.  I have long, fine hair that won't hold curl for anything, and this hairspray helps exponentially. A little product goes a LONG way. Personally, I find that the spray does, in fact, make my fine hair a little crunchy once the product dries.  However, I have long hair, so I wait till the spray dries thoroughly and then shake out my hair (or even gently run a brush or pick thro

claims.text: Many reviewers report the product is fake or a knock-off, citing differences in packaging, ingredients, and labeling from the genuine product.
A common complaint is that the spray does not hold hair or style as the real product does.
Several reviewers note the scent is different from the genuine product, with some describing it as smelling like nail polish.
Some customers report the item cannot be returned due to packaging or other restrictions, leaving them stuck with the product.
Positive reviewers praise the strong hold and fast-drying performance, especially for fine hair and lace front wigs.

qa.q: Does this hairspray hold up in humidity?
qa.answer: Yes, one reviewer says it holds up well in humid Wisconsin summers and gives all-day hold [1]. No reviews report it failing in humidity.

claims.text: It helps hair hold up well in humid Wisconsin summers and provides all-day hold.

qa.q: Will it leave white flakes or residue in my hair?
qa.answer: One review reports a dull residue left on the hair [6], while another describes the product as not messy when sprayed [1]. No review specifically mentions white flakes.

claims.text: This product leaves a dull residue on your hair taking away shine.
It is not as messy when you spray.

qa.q: How strong is the hold compared to other hairsprays?
qa.answer: Reviewers describe the hold as very strong: it hardens hair immediately and keeps an all-day hold [5][2], and one says it tops other pricey sprays [6]. However, one reviewer notes it makes hair a bit hard [4], and another says it leaves a dull residue [1].

claims.text: It hardens hair immediately and provides an all-day hold.
One reviewer says it tops other pricey sprays by far.
It can make hair a bit hard.
It leaves a dull residue on hair.
